title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Javascript and deploy it via Heroku.
  • Work with the CTO to break down large projects into small shippable slices and execute on those projects.
  • Build API integrations with 3rd party software providers
  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks
  • Create and review pull requests in Github.


Why Work at StayFi?

  • You’ll be working directly with the CTO and CEO on mission critical projects.
  • You’ll get mentorship directly from the CTO and senior engineers who can help you go from being a junior or mid-level engineer to being a true master.
  • As you continue to do good work and help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to learn the ins and outs of running a sustainable and growing business.
  • You’ll be working on a small team, so you’ll get the chance to have a large impact within our company and in the vacation rental industry at large.

title: Staff Product Engineer (Software)
description:
Staff Product Engineer (Software)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Compensation: $60,000 USD / year

Annual Bonus: $6,000 (10%)

Backed By: Top Silicon Valley investors — Y Combinator, Liquid 2, Founder of Instacart, Founder of Reddit

Stage: High-growth consumer health tech subscription product generating $1M/month , compounding 15% MoM

TAM: $29.4B in the U.S. (100M people). ~600M people globally.

Career Growth: As our first full-time Staff Engineer , you will set engineering standards, establish technical direction, and grow the engineering team.


About the Job

As a Staff Software Engineer on Product , you will directly shape our customer-facing web app (tens of thousands of MAU) and own our highest-priority engineering initiatives. You’ll partner closely with the Product Designer, both Founders, and lead our engineering team to build reliable software that drives customer retention and product velocity.

You’ll spend ~75% of your time writing code and ~25% on technical direction, architectural decisions, and collaborating on the product roadmap .

You will operate in a Build → Measure → Learn + Iterate product loop.


About You

  • 8+ years building full-stack applications with Python and JavaScript
  • 4+ years of production React experience
  • Able to translate Figma designs into scalable React/Python implementations
  • Strong product-growth instincts and experience with event instrumentation
  • Skilled with PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar tools
  • Exceptional communicator who builds trust, aligns teams, and drives decisions
  • Staff-level depth: setting technical direction, making architectural tradeoffs, delivering impact
  • Adept at balancing technical debt, infra cost, engineering hours, and time-to-ship
  • Comfortable in fast-paced startup environments where engineers own infra end-to-end


Our Stack

  • Python (FastAPI) — backend
  • TypeScript (React) — frontend
  • Postgres (Supabase)
  • PostHog for product analytics
  • AWS
  • GitHub


What You’ll Do1. Build

  • Work with the Product Designer and Founders to define the technical direction
  • Translate customer feedback and Figma screens into clear technical requirements
  • Break down work across yourself + 2 Full-Stack Engineers + 1 AI Engineer
  • Own architecture, core features, and high-quality implementation
  • Improve reliability, scalability, and maintainability across the codebase

2. Measure

  • Instrument all necessary customer events inside our web app
  • Ensure PostHog receives clean, reliable data for evaluating retention and feature impact

3. Learn + Iterate

  • Partner with the Product Designer and CTO to build charts/dashboards in PostHog
  • Extract insights quickly to inform product decisions
  • Ship iterations rapidly and maintain a fast learning cycle

title: Estagiário
description:
Orgulho de ser Camil!


É com a força dos mais de 6 mil colaboradores presentes no Brasil, Uruguai, Chile, Peru e Equador que estamos rumo a um futuro promissor. Gente do passado, presente e futuro, foram e continuarão sendo fundamentais para a construção da nossa empresa que, sem deixar de ser simples, continua crescendo e inovando.


Estamos mais fortes do que nunca e acreditamos que através da riqueza que há nas pessoas, engajamos o nosso time para continuar alcançando os melhores resultados.


Nossas vagas estão abertas para todas e todos, independentemente da idade, deficiência, raça, gênero ou orientação sexual.


Venha construir uma carreira de sucesso!


#souarrozcomfeijão



Responsabilidades:

  • Análise e acompanhamento de KPI's: MAPE, BIAS, OTIF, CFR;
  • Avaliação de tendências, riscos e oportunidades para a malha de distribuição logística;
  • Desenvolvimento de Dashboards de indicadores de performance;
  • Apoiar na organização e análise de dados de estoques mitigando riscos de descarte;
  • Apoiar na manutenção de sistemas e ferramentas de planejamento;
  • Forte interação com as áreas: Vendas, Marketing, Produção e Logística.


Requisitos:

  • Excel intermediário;
  • Desejável conhecimento em SQL / Power BI;
  • Necessário conhecimento em Python;
  • Perfil analítico, proatividade e boa comunicação;
  • Interesse em Supply Chain e planejamento estratégico.

title: Global CRM Sustain & Operations Lead
description:
Global CRM Sustain & Operations Lead


As a Sustain & Operations Lead, you will be responsible for the management, quality, analysis, and lead of Global CRM system under your responsibility following the appropriate methodologies.


The functions are:


  • Provide Recommendations, Action Plans, and Status Updates to Leadership and Key Stakeholders
  • Manage Key Relationships with Business and Technical Stakeholders
  • Interaction with key users of the applications and Align application services with business goals to ensure efficiency and value delivery
  • Continually mature Sustain & Operational/Platform processes to meet Otis needs & requirements
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of the production environment, ensuring system stability, performance, reliability & quality
  • Ensuring adherence to all policies, procedures, KPI’s, SLA’s, best practices are being properly tracked & completed. Continue to enhance & mature proper tracking/adherence with vendors/teams.
  • Focus, shorten & fine tune KPI’s to ensure internal teams are focused on correcting the area’s that provide most value
  • Enforce/champion/leverage & expand our AI usage/capabilities in day-to-day operations with internal sustain/workstream teams (includes vendors)
  • Continue to improve reports on support activities, incident trends, and system health for stakeholders
  • Promote continuous improvement by identifying automation opportunities and process enhancements
  • Ensure/Drive Problem Management and follow best in class practices, implementing preventive measures and meeting Otis level objectives
  • Troubleshooting issues, coordinating with development teams, and implementing best practices for incident management and resolution
  • Ensure/enforce the integrity, data, administration, configuration, maintenance of all Global CRM environments (non-production & production)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (developers, business analysts, cyber, infrastructure teams) to address complex technical challenges
  • Ensure/implement production monitoring for all integration system connected to production CRM & address any monitoring coverage gaps
  • Assist with new global initiatives with the Global CRM Implementation & Rollout COE team
  • Lead the audit/compliance initiatives for Global CRM, working with the auditing/compliance/DR teams
  • Approve /coordinate with appropriate teams/vendors on the environment server/maintenance upgrades/license management/platform items
  • Ensure proper documentation for system configurations, flow diagrams, troubleshooting steps, support processes & interfaces.
  • Push for automation and eliminate manual efforts.
  • Ensure adherence to IT security policies, data privacy regulations, and compliance standards
  • Ensure the integrity, environment synchronization, configuration, and maintenance of Global CRM environments (non-production & production)
  • Oversee/enhance usage of ITIL processes such as Incident Management, Change Management, and Service Delivery


Qualifications:


  • 5 years of experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365
  • Experience in ITLM
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Platform (Sales Module) highly preferred
  • Experience with MS Azure Dev Ops (ADO) tool preferred, but not required
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops with key stakeholders across multiple Functional Areas and Geographic Areas

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Buscamos uma pessoa Product Owner apaixonada por dados, performance e qualidade, para atuar na evolução do ecossistema de relatórios em Data Fabric, garantindo integridade, governança e eficiência no consumo das informações.

Se você domina GraphQL, APIs, análise de payloads e backlog de produto, e gosta de ambientes ágeis, técnicos e colaborativos, esse desafio é a sua cara!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Definir, priorizar e manter o backlog de funcionalidades e histórias de usuário relacionadas ao consumo de dados e geração de relatórios.
  • Atuar como principal stakeholder na validação de entregas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Definir padrões de requisição, resposta e manipulação de payloads complexos para consumo de APIs.
  • Construir e otimizar queries GraphQL para extração e composição dos dados no Orquestrador de Relatórios.
  • Trabalhar com Engenharia na definição de schemas, governança e padronização das APIs.
  • Liderar análises de dados migrados de sistemas legados, garantindo integridade e equivalência.
  • Definir e coordenar Testes de Equivalência (Equivalence Testing) entre legado e Data Fabric.
  • Colaborar com Data Stewards e Engenharia de Dados para entender origem, tratamento e disponibilização dos dados.
  • Conduzir discovery e refinamento de requisitos complexos, garantindo soluções escaláveis e performáticas.


Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Proficiência em GraphQL API
  • Análise de payloads e arquivos .JSON
  • Data Quality Monitoring
  • Conhecimento em ambientes de cloud
  • Análise exploratória de datasets
  • Gerenciamento de backlog (Jira)
  • Planejamento de sprints e priorização
  • Criação de personas e histórias de usuário
  • Monitoramento de KPIs e OKRs
  • Visão de produto e definição de roadmap
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Experiência com Data Fabric ou arquiteturas distribuídas de dados
  • Background em migração de sistemas legados
  • Experiência com times de engenharia de dados, data stewardship e qualidade de dados
  • Conhecimento em modelos de dados e governança
  • Experiência no setor financeiro ou produtos de dados
  • Inglês avançado/fluente


Formato de trabalho: Remoto.


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um projeto global do nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , assumindo um papel técnico-estratégico dedicado ao Azure DevOps (ADO) e às plataformas de dados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Trabalhar com estruturas de dados de média a alta complexidade em ambiente corporativo.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on com SQL para manipulação e análise de dados.
  • Transformar dados utilizando Azure Data Factory (ADF), incluindo criação e otimização de pipelines.
  • Implementar lógica e análises utilizando DAX.
  • Modelar dados (normalização, desnormalização e star schema).
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos DBT, incluindo criação de testes de dados.
  • Atuar com soluções em Azure para armazenamento, integração e processamento de dados.
  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes Azure DevOps: acessos, permissões, configurações de projeto, repositórios e integrações.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos e externos para avaliar automações, integrações e fluxos customizados dentro do Azure DevOps.
  • Oferecer direcionamento técnico sobre uso avançado da plataforma Azure DevOps, incluindo escalabilidade e integrações com GitHub, ServiceNow e serviços Azure.
  • Criar e manter automações utilizando Power Platform (principalmente Power Automate).
  • Comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos técnicos e não técnicos em inglês.


O que você precisa ter

  • Forte experiência em administração de Azure DevOps (ADO) e pipelines.
  • Experiência sólida com Power Platform, principalmente Power Automate.
  • SQL avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência com ADF, Data Pipelines e orquestração de dados.
  • Conhecimento em DBT e DAX.
  • Conhecimentos de Azure Infrastructure.
  • Experiência em liderança técnica.
  • Perfil com forte senso de ownership e visão de dono da solução.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

Experiência com Python ou PowerQuery/Power BI.

Certificações relevantes:

  • DP-203 – Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • PL-500 – Power Platform Developer Associate

Experiência em ambientes corporativos com estruturas de dados complexas.

Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção a detalhes.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor – Full-Time)

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.


WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. You think about content as part of a bigger narrative, not just a single post. You love collaborating with others, working fast, and iterating based on feedback.


WHAT WE NEED

ODDITY is seeking a Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor) to join our Growth Marketing and Organic Social team as we launch a new brand under the ODDITY portfolio.

This role will help define how the brand looks and feels across social media — shaping everything from post design to campaign visuals and creator-led content. You’ll translate ideas into cohesive, scroll-stopping creative that drives engagement, conversation, and brand awareness. We’re looking for someone who’s deeply tuned into social trends, understands the balance of storytelling and aesthetics, and can bring a strategic eye to organic social design.

Note: Our team works EST hours, and candidates should be available during standard business hours.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design a variety of assets for organic and paid social , including carousels, post graphics, stories, and light video edits
  • Help establish the visual identity for a new ODDITY brand , ensuring consistency and cohesion across platforms
  • Partner with marketing and creative teams to interpret briefs and bring ideas to life in visually impactful ways
  • Repurpose and adapt content for different social formats and trends
  • Collaborate closely with copywriters, growth leads, and creators to build assets that feel fresh, social-first, and culturally relevant


YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design for marketing or social media
  • Proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (After Effects or Premiere a plus, but not required)
  • Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy
  • Proven ability to design for social performance — balancing brand polish with native, engaging formats
  • Basic familiarity with AI design tools and interest in emerging creative technologies
  • Strong attention to detail and time management
  • Excellent communication skills and openness to collaboration and feedback
  • Impressive work ethic and willingness to work in a fast-paced and high-growth environment
  • Full written and spoken English proficiency


BONUS POINTS

  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram aesthetics and trends
  • Experience supporting brand launches or rebrands


WHO WE ARE

ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. Using data science, AI, and tech innovation, we serve over 40 million users through personalized product experiences.

ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and is now building its next breakthrough brand — launching soon.


With headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and a biotechnology lab in Boston, ODDITY operates at the intersection of tech, science, and creativity. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and impact-driven — ideal for those who thrive on building from the ground up.

title: Tech Lead Back-End (Golang)
description:
Tech Lead Back-End | Golang | Startup B2B em Crescimento


Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead Back-End para ser o pilar técnico e de liderança em nossa startup B2B em crescimento acelerado.


Se você é um(a) líder nato(a), pensa de forma analítica e quer ter autonomia total para moldar a arquitetura de um produto que está escalando clientes e soluções, essa é a sua chance de construir algo grande conosco!


O Desafio e o Seu Impacto


Você será a peça-chave na evolução técnica e estratégica do nosso produto. Seu foco será garantir que a tecnologia acompanhe a nossa curva de crescimento, transformando decisões técnicas em valor de negócio tangível.


Liderança e Mentoria: Liderar e apoiar diretamente um time de Back-End de 2 a 3 desenvolvedores(as).


Visão Estratégica: Definir e evoluir a arquitetura do produto, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e resiliência.


Qualidade e Performance: Estabelecer e fiscalizar padrões de código e boas práticas, assegurando que o produto seja robusto.


Ownership de Ponta a Ponta: Atuar com autonomia total para levar projetos desde a concepção arquitetural até a entrega em produção, em colaboração estreita com o Time de Produto.


Driver de Resultados: Garantir entregas consistentes, mantendo o foco em otimizar soluções para o contexto B2B.


Requisitos Essenciais:


Domínio em Golang (Avançado): Experiência robusta e aprofundada é imprescindível.


Experiência em Arquiteturas Escaláveis: Vivência na concepção e manutenção de APIs e sistemas de alto desempenho.


Experiência em Liderança: Histórico comprovado na liderança de pessoas ou times técnicos.


Ambiente Cloud: Conhecimento prático em qualquer provedor de Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).


Vivência em Startup/B2B: Experiência prévia em ambientes de startup ou com produtos B2B.


Diferenciais (Não Obrigatórios):


Conhecimento em filas e mensagerias.


Experiência com GCP (Google Cloud Platform).


Vivência com modelos SaaS (Software as a Service).


Remuneração: R$ 12.500 Fixo + Variável + Benefícios


Modelo de Contratação: PJ

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de Segurança Mobile  - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 17 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Analista de Segurança Mobile- Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Android: Kotlin/Java + Android Security (Keystore, FLAG_SECURE).
  • iOS: Swift/Objective-C + Keychain, Secure Enclave, snapshot protection.
  • Integração com React Native.
  • OWASP MASVS e OWASP Mobile Top 10.
  • Certificate Pinning e proteção de credenciais.
  • Ofuscação de código e prevenção contra engenharia reversa.
  • Experiência com SDKs de segurança embarcadas.
  • Vivência com JWT, OAuth 2.0;
  • Experiência em pipelines de CI/CD para apps mobile;
  • Criptografia aplicada: AES, RSA, SHA-256, HMAC, etc.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com segurança adaptativa;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de SAST, DAST e IAST para mobile.
  • Conhecimento em soluções de SSO entre múltiplos apps.
  • Experiência com integração de soluções de CAPTCHA e App Shielding.


Formação: Superior Completo ou em fase de conclusão até 2026 na área de TI



O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Android: Kotlin/Java + Android Security (Keystore, FLAG_SECURE).
  • iOS: Swift/Objective-C + Keychain, Secure Enclave, snapshot protection.
  • Integração com React Native.
  • OWASP MASVS e OWASP Mobile Top 10.
  • Certificate Pinning e proteção de credenciais.
  • Ofuscação de código e prevenção contra engenharia reversa.
  • Experiência com SDKs de segurança embarcadas.
  • Vivência com JWT, OAuth 2.0;
  • Experiência em pipelines de CI/CD para apps mobile;
  • Criptografia aplicada: AES, RSA, SHA-256, HMAC, etc.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com segurança adaptativa;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de SAST, DAST e IAST para mobile.
  • Conhecimento em soluções de SSO entre múltiplos apps.
  • Experiência com integração de soluções de CAPTCHA e App Shielding.


Formação: Superior Completo ou em fase de conclusão até 2026 na área de TI

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Desenvolvedor Júnior (Microsoft Power Platform)
description:
Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo nas áreas de tecnologia, desenvolvimento ou afins;
  • Inglês Básico.


Habilidades Técnicas

  • Power BI, Power Automate e Power App;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software Web e banco de dados;
  • Experiência em SQL e Análise de Dados;
  • Habilidades em Python, JavaScript, React, html5, CSS3, construção de API e microserviços;
  • Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários;
  • Programação de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando Power BI / Power Platform, bem como as linguagens suportadas na plataforma ArcGIS .


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Modelagem de dados e estatística.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.


Responsabilidades:

  • Colaborar com as áreas de negócio na identificação dos requisitos, design e implantação da solução;
  • Criar fluxos automatizados entre aplicações e serviços utilizando o Microsoft Power Platform: Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate e Power Pages;
  • Desenvolver e manter Dashboards no Microsoft Power BI;
  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;
  • Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos;
  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, através da conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido, junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Escrever o plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

title: Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant to join our Global D365 Blueprint Maintenance Team. This role focuses on supporting L3 and L4 bug fixes and managing change requests related to localization and legal requirements in the LATAM market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide functional expertise in Dynamics 365 Finance modules: GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Budgeting, Cash & Bank, Tax.
  • Ensure compliance with Finance Localizations for South America, primarily Brazil and Argentina.
  • Collaborate with global teams to maintain and enhance the D365 blueprint.
  • Address change requests arising from localization or legal changes.


Requirements

  • Deep knowledge of D365 Finance modules and ERP lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of financial principles and accounting standards.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps. Familiarity with Power Platform is a plus.
  • Proficiency in documentation and stakeholder communication.
  • Advanced English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.
  • Flexibility to work slightly earlier hours for overlap with CET (8 AM – 5 PM).


Why choose us?

title: Application Specialist
description:
TITAN is a no-code, web-based platform within the Salesforce ecosystem for seamless form creation, data collection, and workflow automation.


We are looking to hire an Application Specialist to join our Solutions team. This role will focus on building logical workflows, helping customize the platform to client needs, and collaborating with global teams to design and implement tailored technical solutions.


This role is perfect for someone analytical, communicative, and globally curious - someone who enjoys digging into the “why” not just the “how”, and who is both business and tech/logic oriented.


The ideal candidate has studied informations systems or industrial engineering and has recently graduated.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement logic-driven processes to fit unique client workflows
  • Provide technical support and guide clients through the onboarding process
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into actionable solutions
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams
  • Investigate edge cases and troubleshoot issues
  • Advise clients on ways to improve performance and optimize their projects


Requirements:

  • Recent graduate (up to 1 year post-graduation) with a degree in Industrial Engineering (Information Systems focus) or Information Systems .
  • Strong academic performance in Algorithms, Databases, and Programming
  • Excellent analytical skills and structured logical thinking
  • Fluent in English
  • Background in technical support, software implementation, or system configuration is a plus
  • Familiarity with APIs, data structures, and system integration tools is an advantage


Why Join TITAN?:

  • Work with globally distributed, multicultural teams
  • Get exposure to a wide range of clients and industries
  • Real professional growth from day one
  • Help shape technical solutions that directly impact client success


Important Note: To be considered, please attach your university transcript when applying.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Scrum Master

Location: Remote (Brazil/Argentina)

Full time


Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies with purpose and discipline; ensuring teams remain focused on delivering value each sprint.
  • Remove impediments swiftly, enabling teams to maintain steady progress and high productivity.
  • Coach teams in agile principles and Scrum practices, promoting ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Act as a trusted liaison between product teams, stakeholders, and leadership, ensuring transparent communication and timely alignment.
  • Guide cross-functional teams in planning, estimation, prioritization, and adaptive delivery.
  • Support Product Owners in refining and managing the backlog to ensure clarity and readiness.
  • Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, metrics, and actionable insights.
  • Foster a culture of transparency, trust, and open communication across all levels.
  • Manage risks, dependencies, and team dynamics with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
  • Oversee reporting of team performance and progress, providing concise updates for leadership visibility.
  • Coordinate effectively with external vendors and partners, ensuring alignment and accountability.


What You Bring

  • Scrum Master Certification (CSM, PSM, PMI-ACP) strongly preferred.
  • 5–7+ years of experience working with agile teams in dynamic or enterprise environments.
  • Proven success facilitating cross-functional collaboration and guiding teams through complex initiatives.
  • Strong background in hybrid delivery environments integrating Agile and traditional practices.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence, coach, and present confidently at all levels.
  • Demonstrated experience managing vendor relationships and external partners.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Job Title: Frontend Developer – React / Svelte / Astro (Smart TV & Embedded Devices)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain web applications for Smart TVs and embedded environments.
  • Implement software design patterns and best practices for scalable, maintainable code.
  • Collaborate with Agile teams, product managers, and stakeholders to define requirements and functional designs.
  • Integrate with REST APIs and third-party SDKs effectively.
  • Advocate for high-quality software and excellent user experience across all platforms.
  • Write unit tests, perform test-driven development, and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Assist in QA automation using Selenium or equivalent tools.
  • Debug and optimize front-end applications for performance and reliability.


Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript development.
  • 3+ years of experience with multiple frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Astro).
  • Experience in non-browser environments such as Smart TVs and embedded devices.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with unit testing, branching patterns, CI/CD, and TDD.
  • Knowledge of Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced Agile environment.
  • Strong focus on consumer-oriented development and attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to interact with business partners and technical teams.

title: Survey Photogrammetry Processor
description:
O Survey Photogrammetry Processor é essencial para garantir precisão, acurácia, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados de fotogrametria utilizados em decisões estratégicas e geração de insights. A função envolve processamento e análise de dados para projetos de fotogrametria, incluindo preparação, suporte em campo, processamento, controle de qualidade, elaboração de relatórios finais e encerramento de projetos.


Local : Brasil (trabalho remoto),

Principais responsabilidades

  • Processar dados de fotogrametria desde a calibração de cameras até a criação de modelos completos.
  • Realizar controle de qualidade e análise para garantir a integridade dos dados.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Apoiar metodologias de levantamento e otimização de processos.
  • Atuar com softwares especializados e ferramentas estatísticas.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em área relacionada ou experiência equivalente.
  • Vasta experiência em fotogrametria onshore/offshore.
  • Conhecimento em gestão e análise de dados, mapeamento e softwares específicos.
  • Familiaridade com M365, AutoCAD e processos de fotogrametria.
  • Inglês técnico e capacidade de trabalho remoto.

Desejável

Conhecimento em Agisoft Metashape.

Linguagem de programação como Python, C++ e R.

Habilidade em redação técnica.

title: Senior Frontend UX Engineer
description:
Senior Frontend UX Engineer

Location: Brazil, Mexico (Remote)

Type: Brazil Contract / Mexico Full-time


Pluto TV is looking for an experienced Senior Frontend UX Engineer for the development of new as well as enhancement of existing applications. Applications include Command Center and related MFEs, plus other applications owned by our sister teams including Content Systems, Media Asset Management System (MAM), Content Management System (CMS), Content Feeds Services (CFEEDS), and Revenue. Candidates must have hands-on experience with Javascript, React, CSS Components Design and similar JavaScript-based technologies, strong experience working in highly technical teams, and proven experience building solutions with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, ECS, and more.


Responsibilities Include

This is a critical role with a wide range of responsibilities including:

  • Creating and modifying mocked versions of new UI screens using existing components
  • Creating and modifying custom React and web components including unit tests
  • Understanding responsive design and creating UX integrations in a responsive way
  • Participating in code reviews and ensure more junior developers adhere to team's best practices and processes
  • Actively participating in the design & architecture phases of upcoming features and services
  • Working collaboratively and productively with other project team members from Product, Program Management, and QA
  • Providing realistic (not optimistic) LOE estimates during Quarterly PI planning, accounting for likely setbacks and external constraints
  • Prototyping new technologies to reduce cost and increase engineer velocity


Must Have Qualities & Experience

The right individual for our team must have the following skills and experience to be successful in this role:

  • Deep experience in Javascript and Nodejs
  • Knowledge of frontend web development and common tools used in the wider frontend ecosystem such as popular frameworks and npm
  • Familiarity with common programming tools such as Redux, IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools
  • An understanding of common programming paradigms and fundamental Frontend programming principles such as modular components, hooks, and lifecycle events
  • 5 years of software engineering experience
  • 2 years of experience developing frontend applications using React or similar, Node, and GIT source control
  • 2 years of experience building highly scalable, performant, and responsive web applications
  • 2 years of experience developing applications deployed to the cloud (AWS/GCP)
  • 2 years of Typescript experience
  • Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills
  • Ability to work within a distributed team


Nice To Have Qualities & Experience

The best candidate for our team will have the following skills and experience:

  • BS degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Experience with web components and Lit HTML
  • Experience with Go Lang
  • VOD Streaming experience
  • Release devops CI/CD experience (GitHub actions, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with microfrontends
  • Experience creating and building with component design systems

description:

Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.

- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Training Coordinator
description:
About NIIT


NIIT is a leading Skills and Talent Development Corporation that is building a manpower pool for global industry requirements. The company, which was set up in 1981 to help the nascent IT industry overcome its human resource challenges, today ranks among the world’s leading training companies owing to its vast, yet comprehensive array of talent development programs. With a footprint across 40 nations, NIIT offers training and development solutions to Individuals, Enterprises, and Institutions.


Link to our LinkedIn Page -

Link to our website -

Position: Training Coordinator


We are looking for our next training operations coordinator. This role is part of the Operations team and supports NIIT’s customer(s) in Frankfurt.

to deliver outstanding service.

We all work together on a common project with part of the team based in India.

As a training operations coordinator, you will be reporting to the training operations manager.

You will be the key contact point for all local stakeholders, coordinating training session delivery. You will master and oversee all activities within the service.

You will work closely and in partnership with the customer’s learning delivery team.


Roles & Responsibility:


  • Analyze the training needs provided by the Client and determine the number of sessions needed to train the overall number of trainees according to courses and per site,
  • Initiate and manage requests for session creation, modification, completion, and cancellation where required,
  • Organize the training sessions according to trainees’ expectations and availability and ensure their proper execution,
  • Calibrate and coordinate with the Indian team for any changes/updates in the training event/program,
  • Support completion of training activities by following up for attendance and invoice if required,
  • Follow and ensure adherence to the workflow and processes using the CRM tool
  • Ensure Learner Support Level 2


Experience & Skill:


  • 2 to 4 years of experience in learning delivery management and/or operations,
  • Exposure to an international work environment
  • High-level understanding of the training landscape
  • Customer service-oriented posture is a must
  • Team player
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concise thoughts
  • Attention to detail, structured and organized, capable of prioritizing activities
  • Knowledge of Salesforce or any other CRM
  • Knowledge of Cornerstone or any other LMS is an added advantage
  • Fluent in English is a mandatory requirement
  • Proficient in MS Office, Excel, SharePoint


NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Software Development Manager
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled and proactive Software Development Manager to lead our engineering team. In this role, you will oversee daily operations, provide strategic leadership, and drive initiatives to enhance service delivery and customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise with strong people management.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Management role within Encora Brazil Division Global Solutions Team;
  • Technical leadership: Lead complex and multi-disciplinary projects, help the team with problem solving by offering suggestions, technical guidelines and feedback, ensure quality, performance and security. Deliver results and challenge the team, actively working in technical discussions, architecture and other decisions, focused on Development routines;
  • Project Management: ensure valuable deliveries, timeline, ceremonies, project metrics, remove blocks, manage risks, report project status, collect and apply lessons learned, propose changes to the existing SW Development process to achieve better results;
  • People Management: evaluations, IDP, feedback, 1:1, ensure processes are followed, improve productivity, technical and soft skills, motivate the team, provide career direction, hiring and dismissal process, ability to retain talents;
  • Relationship management with multiple stakeholders (both technical and business), taking accountability to deliver software solutions and getting development team’s commitment;
  • Suggest and promote process improvements.



Essential Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or other related areas or equivalent work experience;
  • Experience with Software Development;
  • Experience in a leadership role in software development projects;
  • Experience in delivering software projects, management, building and staffing of software development teams;
  • Manage customer expectations while working with cross-functional teams to meet customer/product delivery goals;
  • Knowledge and experience in agile methodologies;
  • Drive team to innovate and deliver roadmap features with agility and high quality;
  • Hands on profile, actively involved in technical and architectural discussions.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Android Developer (Java) (Req. English)
description:
Fetchly Labs is a forward-thinking technology company specializing in innovative mobile solutions. We work on cutting-edge projects that emphasize user-centric design, scalability, and seamless performance. Join our fully remote team and contribute to developing high-quality Android applications using Java, while collaborating in an agile environment.
Position Overview We are seeking a skilled Android Developer to join our team. You'll build and maintain scalable mobile applications using modern Android development technologies, with a strong emphasis on test-driven development and API integration.
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop native Android applications using Java and modern Android frameworks
  • Design and implement robust mobile architectures following best practices
  • Practice test-driven development for reliable and maintainable code
  • Integrate with RESTful APIs and backend services
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and participate in code reviews
  • Optimize application performance and ensure smooth user experiences
Required Technical Skills Android Development
  • Java for Android (required) - native Android app development using Java with Android SDK
  • Kotlin (preferred) - modern Android development language
  • Android Runtime (ART) and Android SDK fundamentals
  • Android Studio IDE proficiency
  • Android Jetpack components (ViewModel, LiveData, Room, Navigation)
  • Material Design guidelines and UI/UX principles
  • Responsive layouts and multi-device support
  • Java/Kotlin interoperability in mixed codebases
Architecture & Patterns
  • MVVM, MVP, or Clean Architecture
  • Dependency injection (Dagger, Hilt)
  • Reactive programming (RxJava, Coroutines, Flow)
  • Repository pattern and data layer design
Backend Integration
  • RESTful API consumption (Retrofit, OkHttp)
  • JSON parsing and data serialization
  • Authentication and authorization implementation
  • GraphQL (nice to have)
Testing & DevOps
  • Test-driven development methodology
  • Testing frameworks: JUnit, Espresso, Mockito, Robolectric
  • Unit, integration, and UI testing
  • CI/CD pipeline setup (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Jenkins)
  • Version control with Git
Data & Storage
  • SQLite and Room database
  • SharedPreferences and DataStore
  • Local caching strategies
  • Firebase integration (Firestore, Realtime Database)
Nice to Have
  • React Native experience for cross-platform development
  • Flutter knowledge
  • Jetpack Compose for modern UI development
  • Firebase services (Analytics, Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging)
  • In-app purchases and subscription management
  • Google Play Store publishing and release management
  • Push notifications implementation
  • Deep linking and app navigation
  • Performance profiling and optimization tools
Preferred Qualifications
  • 3+ years of professional Android development experience
  • Published apps on Google Play Store
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Understanding of mobile app security best practices
  • Experience with offline-first architecture

title: Sr. SAP F2F (IBP, PP) – Advanced English
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Responsibilities

Configure and provide support for SAP IBP in demand, supply, and inventory planning.

Collaborate with business units to align planning strategies and ensure business objectives are met.

Translate business requirements into SAP functional specifications.

Perform unit testing, integration testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

Ensure compliance with IT change management standards (ITIL), including documentation and user training.


Required Skills & Qualifications

Proven experience configuring business systems software in life sciences, healthcare, or related industries.

Ability to architect and provide technical support for SAP systems and related environments, including IBP and Production Planning.

Strong understanding of SAP Security architecture and implementation methods.

Hands-on experience with SAP S/4 HANA, SAP Cloud Solutions, and Fiori.


Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of Sales & Distribution (SD) configuration and Available-to-Promise (ATP) - a plus

Experience in a hands-on technical role such as technical project management, systems development, or similar roles.

2+ years of experience serving as a subject matter expert in a capacity that is relevant to the area this role will focus/support

Ability to assist with the implementation of project and systems delivery methodologies.

Demonstrated flexibility in adapting to changing end-user business needs.


Language Requirement:

Advanced English


Additional Requirement:

Availability to relocate to Mexico after 3 months and remain there for the duration of the contract


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

title: Airtable Analyst/Project Coordinator
description:
Required Skills & Experience


• 3+ years of professional experience • 1+ years of experience with Airtable • Strong technical aptitude with a developer mindset • Excellent organizational and project management skills • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field


Job Description


In this role, you will collaborate closely with resource managers to track plans, schedule meetings, and coordinate updates with stakeholders. You will maintain and update Airtable based on input from various teams, create and manage runbooks in Confluence, and troubleshoot technical tools and applications as needed. A key part of your responsibilities will involve analyzing feedback from the field and other teams to implement process improvements and ensure alignment across hiring managers, technical managers, and leadership. While the position is primarily remote, you must be willing to commute within 1.5 hours of the Greater Philadelphia area when required.

title: Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Pleno
description:
Missão da área

A área de Desenvolvimento transforma a visão estratégica da Serena em projetos reais, garantindo um pipeline robusto e sustentável. Atua como dona na alocação de capital, buscando excelência, questionando limites e convertendo oportunidades em ativos sólidos. Mantém o cliente no centro das decisões, antecipando riscos e resolvendo problemas relevantes do setor de energia com integridade e ética. A tecnologia é pilar essencial, usando dados, ferramentas digitais e IA para acelerar análises, qualificar decisões e impulsionar inovação. Incorporando soluções tecnológicas, simplifica processos e amplia a capacidade da Serena de gerar valor em um setor em constante evolução.


⚡Principais Responsabilidades

  • Originação e Estruturação de Projetos Mapear oportunidades de novos projetos, mercados e clusters. Realizar triagens iniciais, avaliando viabilidade técnica, regulatória e comercial;
  • Estruturar análises de viabilidade de forma crítica, organizada e consistente;
  • Gestão de Licenciamento e Regulação Acompanhar processos de licenciamento, autorizações e pareceres. Interagir com áreas regulatórias para garantir alinhamento técnico e prazos;
  • Antecipar riscos e sugerir caminhos preventivos;
  • Coordenação e Mobilização da Rede Engajar áreas internas (regulação, jurídico, engenharia, energia, mercado) para destravar temas;
  • Garantir clareza sobre o que cada área precisa entregar e quando;
  • Manter comunicação simples, direta e estruturada para evitar retrabalhos;
  • Preparação de Materiais de Decisão Elaborar apresentações, notas e análises executivas para comitês;
  • Sintetizar informações complexas de forma clara, lógica e orientada à tomada de decisão;
  • Destacar riscos, opções, premissas e recomendações;


Requisitos da Vaga

  • Formação completa em Engenharia;
  • 1–3 anos em desenvolvimento de projetos de energia renovável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de acesso (ONS/ANEEL), normativos do setor elétrico, fundiário, licenciamento ambiental, contratos e análises de recurso;
  • Conhecimento em Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI;
  • Inglês: Fluente.

Diferenciais: programação, MS Project, conhecimento adicional em GIS/QGIS



Soft Skills Desejadas

  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas frentes simultâneas
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva
  • Atenção a detalhes
  • Organização
  • Perfil analítico
  • Proatividade e autonomia
  • Senso de dono e gestão de prazos
  • Resiliência para ambientes complexos

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack SR (Java / Angular)
description:
A T-Systems , multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom, busca Software Engineer com bom nível de idioma inglês (desejável alemão) , para atuar de forma 100% remota, em projetos internacionais.


Como profissional Fullstack você irá:


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento ágil de novas funcionalidades, em parceria com o time da Alemanha (líderes de projeto e arquitetos de software).
  • Fazer parte de um time brasileiro em crescimento , responsável pelo ciclo completo de desenvolvimento em ambiente DevOps , contribuindo para a evolução contínua de uma plataforma estratégica e global.


O que buscamos:


  • Proficiência em Java e/ou Angular;
  • Experiência com Kafka ;
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em Apache Flink , OPC-UA e MQTT;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban etc.);
  • Bom nível de idioma inglês e/ou alemão .


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.


Você atuará em um projeto global, com tecnologias modernas, metodologias ágeis e interação direta com um dos maiores grupos automotivos do mundo.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, colaboração e desafios internacionais, essa é a sua chance de acelerar sua carreira!

title: Senior HPC Cluster Support Engineer (Bright Cluster Manager + Slurm)
description:
Role: HPC Cluster Support – CIBA 4 (Senior)

Position Type: Part-Time Contract (20hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 6 months

Work Hours: EST or PST

Location : 100% Remote


We're seeking a Senior HPC Cluster Support Engineer to maintain and support large-scale production HPC environments running Bright Cluster Manager and Slurm . This role focuses on cluster operations, hardware troubleshooting, user support, and vendor coordination to ensure uninterrupted high-performance computing workloads.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and support HPC clusters: job submission issues, queue management, and user troubleshooting
  • Monitor cluster health and resolve node failures, networking issues, and domain problems
  • Diagnose hardware faults (GPUs, boards, power, nodes) and perform remote checks using BMC tools (Dell iDRAC, HPE iLOM, Supermicro)
  • Troubleshoot InfiniBand , Panasas storage, and network integration issues
  • Coordinate repairs and escalate with vendors (ParkPlace, VDura)
  • Apply system updates, patches, and configurations
  • Collaborate with users and provide regular status updates


Required Skills

  • Strong experience with Bright Cluster Manager and Slurm
  • Linux systems administration and advanced troubleshooting
  • Hardware diagnostics, BMC remote management tools
  • Experience with InfiniBand , HPC storage systems (Panasas), and vendor escalation
  • Active Directory integration for Linux is a plus

description:
Role: HPC Cluster Support – CIBA 4 (Senior)

Position Type: Part-Time Contract (20hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 6 months

Work Hours: EST or PST

Location : 100% Remote


We're seeking a Senior HPC Cluster Support Engineer to maintain and support large-scale production HPC environments running Bright Cluster Manager and Slurm . This role focuses on cluster operations, hardware troubleshooting, user support, and vendor coordination to ensure uninterrupted high-performance computing workloads.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and support HPC clusters: job submission issues, queue management, and user troubleshooting
  • Monitor cluster health and resolve node failures, networking issues, and domain problems

  • Linux systems administration and advanced troubleshooting
  • Hardware diagnostics, BMC remote management tools
  • Experience with InfiniBand , HPC storage systems (Panasas), and vendor escalation
  • Active Directory integration for Linux is a plus

title: Analista de remuneração
description:
Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!

Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Nossa paixão? Cuidar de todos, sejam eles clientes, o planeta ou nossos colaboradores pois as pessoas são importantes para nós.

Trabalhamos para que as pessoas vivam tranquilamente, tanto em seu ambiente físico quanto no digital, a fim de gerar um impacto positivo em sua vida pessoal e profissional.

Com mais de 40 anos de história, presente em 26 países e com mais de 160.000 funcionários em todo o mundo. Somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais do setor de Segurança Privada, que oferece Soluções Integradas de Segurança, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Toda nossa história não seria possível sem um time de heróis e por isso desenvolvemos diariamente programas específicos para atrair novos talentos e promovemos a carreira dos nossos profissionais com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades internas de crescimento.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer segurança inovadora com base nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado. No Brasil, o Grupo Prosegur conta com três linhas de negócio: Segurpro, Prosegur Cash e Cipher. Viva uma excelente experiência, participando de um processo seletivo 100% digital, pois temos equipes dedicadas para garantir a qualidade, segurança e humanização em todas as etapas!

Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora

Conheça esta oportunidade de trabalho na Segurpro/ Cash e se você possui os requisitos para a vaga, FAÇA JÁ A SUA INSCRIÇÃO.

* Vaga aberta a pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Se você é PCD e possui os requisitos e interesse , junte-se à nossa equipe de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo e venha ser Protagonista de uma história de sucesso!


ATIVIDADES A SEREM DESENVOLVIDAS:

  • Manutenção e atualização da estrutura de cargos e faixas salariais.
  • Realização de análises salariais internas e de mercado.
  • Apoio em movimentações salariais, promoções e revisões.
  • Elaboração de relatórios e dashboards com dados de remuneração e headcount.
  • Participação em ciclos de remuneração anual (bônus, méritos, revisão salarial).
  • Condução de processos de descrição e avaliação de cargos.
  • Suporte técnico a gestores e parceiros de RH.
  • Estudo de impacto orçamentário e aplicação de convenções coletivas (CCT).
  • Atualização de organogramas e estruturas funcionais.
  • Governança dos sistemas organizacionais e bases de dados.
  • Desenvolvimento de dashboards.
  • Apoio em projetos de redesenho organizacional.


REQUISITOS IMPRESCINDÍVEIS PARA A INSCRIÇÃO:

  • Formação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Atuação anterior com estrutura organizacional e cargos.
  • Atuação anterior em remuneração, cargos e salários.
  • Excel e Power-BI avançado.

title: Data Engineer – Databricks | Azure (Inglês Avançado)
description:
A UPBI Data & AI , consultoria especializada em soluções digitais, parceira Microsoft e Databricks, está buscando um(a) Data Engineer com sólida experiência em Databricks e Azure para atuação em projeto internacional estratégico.


Modelo: Remoto

Regime: PJ


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados utilizando Databricks e serviços Azure .
  • Programar em Python para manipulação, integração e transformação de dados.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de governança utilizando Unity Catalog e Delta Lake .
  • Realizar versionamento e automações via Azure DevOps .
  • Desenvolver métricas/indicadores em Power BI , quando necessário.
  • Atuar em projeto internacional , colaborando com equipes em horário comercial dos EUA.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Mínimo 3 anos de experiência como Data Engineer
  • Experiência prática com Databricks
  • Azure DevOps / Azure Data Platform
  • Python para engenharia de dados
  • Unity Catalog
  • Power BI
  • Inglês fluente (condução de reuniões e comunicação direta com cliente)
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em horário internacional (EUA)


Diferenciais:


  • Atuação anterior em projetos internacionais
  • Experiência em consultoria
  • Certificações Microsoft ou Databricks

title: Sr. Frontend Developer
description:
Sr. React Developer


Requirements:


●English Advanced (B2 / C1)


● 5+ years of experience in a hands-on software engineering role in frontend web

development.

● Strong expertise in the following: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Typescript.

● Experience with modern web technologies such as React, Preact, GraphQL, Angular,

Next, Vue or Meteor.

● Exposure to architectural patterns of a large, high-scale web application

● Awareness of cross-browser compatibility issues and client-side performance

Considerations.

● Demonstrated design and UX sensibilities.

● Excellent engineering and coding skills.

● Strong communication skills and experience working closely with other engineering

teams across complex interfaces

● Love collaborating via code reviews and architecture discussions, and are motivated to

improve their teammates’ productivity.

to large engineering organization.

● Experience (beyond configuration) working with bundlers, testing frameworks,

editor integrations, frontend build/CI systems, observability tooling, or developer

environments.

● Show motivation for personal growth and learning new technologies to support

the team’s needs.

● Demonstrated design and UX sensibilities.

● Strong communication skills and experience working closely with other engineering

● Love collaborating via code reviews and architecture discussions, and are motivated to

improve their teammates’ productivity.

Nice to have:

● Experience working on an Infrastructure or Platform team supporting a medium

to large engineering organization.

● Experience (beyond configuration) working with bundlers, testing frameworks,

editor integrations, frontend build/CI systems, observability tooling, or developer

environments.

● Show motivation for personal growth and learning new technologies to support

the team’s needs.

title: Visual Designer (UX/UI)

⚠️ Web Design challenge is going to be required ⚠️


Who we are


Uitify is a brand and growth partner for early-stage SaaS companies. We help ambitious startups define their positioning, design their identity, and communicate with clarity and personality — across every touchpoint. We combine strategy, design, and content to build brands that are consistent, memorable, and conversion-driven.

We work fast, collaborate closely, and care deeply about doing work that’s both smart and beautiful.


Who we’re looking for


We’re looking for a Visual Designer who brings strong visual direction, consistency, and creativity. You’ll work closely with our branding, marketing, and product teams to design clean, modern, and conversion-focused assets for fast-growing SaaS companies.

This is a hands-on creative role — ideal for someone who thrives on bringing ideas to life and shaping the visual expression of digital-first brands.


What you’ll do


  • Design and deliver high-quality visual assets: landing pages, pitch decks, social media creatives, eBooks, case studies, and more
  • Ensure consistency and alignment across all brand touchpoints
  • Collaborate with strategists, copywriters, and product designers to translate ideas into strong visuals
  • Contribute to branding, product, and marketing initiatives with a focus on performance and clarity
  • Present and discuss your work with the team and, occasionally, with clients


What we’re looking for


  • A strong portfolio showcasing digital design (branding, marketing, web, presentations, etc.)
  • 5+ years of experience;
  • Proficiency in Webflow, Figma or Framer, figma/canva/photoshop are differentials;
  • A sharp eye for layout, typography, hierarchy, and color
  • Experience designing for SaaS or B2B tech products
  • Ability to handle multiple projects with clarity, speed, and organization
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail


Bonus points


  • Experience working with SaaS companies or startups
  • Experience with People Analytics or B.I.
  • Basic knowledge of UX principles and how design influences user behavior
  • Motion design or video editing skills
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently
  • A proactive, collaborative mindset and a passion for visual storytelling

At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.
