title: Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience using Ruby on Rails to join as a core member of our U.S. client's tight-knit, experienced engineering team. In this role, you will play a leadership role as well as actively contribute to strategizing and building at the feature level rather than just focusing on outputs.

Our client is a venture capital-backed health tech company transforming the industry's coding practices by creating a marketplace that connects healthcare companies with over 4,000 certified coding specialists. The client is focused on expanding quickly its product, engineering, and design teams with passionate builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment to support its rapid growth.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering and product stakeholders to define, design, and build new features and integrations
  • Advance software platform capabilities using Ruby on Rails
  • Develop and support third-party integrations with B2B healthcare systems
  • Provide work estimates for bug fixes, enhancements, and features
  • Deliver high-quality, well-documented code with velocity
  • Mentor junior engineers and aid the engineering team with troubleshooting
  • Write and execute unit tests
  • Promote development best practices following team standards with an eye towards innovation and opportunities to scale
  • Work independently with minimal need for oversight and a bias towards action as well as display a willingness to ask questions when needed to remain efficient
  • Become energized by tackling new challenges and eagerly give and receive feedback from colleagues


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience using Ruby on Rails, including version 7+, with a strong background in JavaScript and frameworks (preferably Stimulus)
  • Experience taking the lead on complete features, appropriate to your level, and showing initiative to solve ambiguous problems
  • Experience creating and consuming APIs
  • Knowledge of relational / non-relational database systems
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience in healthcare, healthtech industry, or growth stage startups
  • Experience with Stimulus, Turbo, Tailwind, Sidekiq, or Heroku Shield


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Especialista em sistemas de granadas
description:
US$ 1100 – 2800 por mês

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar tarefas de guarda e patrulha
  • Deslocamentos à linha de frente
  • Proteger objetos estratégicos e infraestrutura crítica
  • Realizar tarefas de preparo de posições para defesa

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para atuar por longos períodos no campo
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

  • Operar e manter em bom estado os sistemas de mísseis antitanque
  • Executar tarefas táticas com a unidade, incluindo vários tipos de manobras e disposição técnica

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Boa resistência física
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Aptidão para o serviço militar por questões de saúde
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Experiência militar será um diferencial
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

title: Software Engineer (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI)
description:
Role: Software Engineer – Investments (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI))

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Hours: CST

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote (Candidates Can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our Investments Technology team , helping design and build secure, scalable healthcare and identity management platforms . You’ll work across the stack using C#, .NET 8+, Azure , and Angular , while leveraging GitHub Copilot and other GenAI tools to accelerate development and innovation.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on cloud-native, event-driven systems that power secure healthcare and financial applications in a collaborative, remote-first environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and Build Scalable Solutions: Develop secure, high-performance applications using C#, .NET 8+, Entity Framework , and SQL .
  • Architect Modern Systems: Implement REST APIs, event-driven microservices , and integrations using Azure Service Bus and API Management (APIM) .
  • Leverage Azure Cloud: Deploy and manage applications on Azure App Service , integrate messaging, and expose APIs securely.
  • Implement Secure Authentication: Enhance identity management solutions using OAuth2 and OpenID Connect for secure access control.
  • Develop Front-End Interfaces: Build responsive UIs with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML to deliver excellent user experiences.
  • Optimize Data & APIs: Write efficient SQL queries, design APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger , and use Copilot to automate documentation.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with Product, DevOps, and QA to deliver seamless, high-quality releases within CI/CD pipelines .
  • Innovate with GenAI: Use GitHub Copilot and prompt engineering to generate code, API specs, and test scripts, boosting productivity and speed.


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building production-grade applications with C# and .NET Core/8+ .
  • Strong understanding of REST , event-driven , and microservice architectures.
  • Experience with Azure App Service, Service Bus, and APIM .
  • Proficiency in SQL and Entity Framework for database interactions.
  • Front-end experience with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML .
  • Expertise with OpenAPI/Swagger for API documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or similar GenAI tools.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in remote, cross-functional teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) or other IAM platforms.
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (HIPAA) and secure data handling.
  • Exposure to Azure Event Hubs , Kafka , or AutoGen frameworks.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Sênior (Home Office)
description:
Resumo da oportunidade:

Você fará parte de um time que cria e evolui soluções no ecossistema Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud. O papel envolve desenvolvimento com alta qualidade e performance, integrações e desenho de dados, colaborando com equipes de projeto e interagindo com suporte global em inglês.


Responsabilidades do dia a dia:

  • Implementar funcionalidades no Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce/Aura) com foco em performance e qualidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações com APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata) e orquestrar processos com Flow.
  • Modelar dados e desenhar soluções aderentes ao Service Cloud.
  • Participar ativamente das definições técnicas com as equipes de projeto, propondo melhorias.
  • Versionar código com Git e colaborar em práticas ágeis do time.
  • Acompanhar novidades do Salesforce e aplicar quando fizer sentido.
  • Atuar em esquema de plantão fora do horário comercial, em rodízio com o time.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de implementação e customização no Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Stack: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, LWC, Aura, batches, triggers e schedules.
  • Integrações: experiência com Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata).
  • Arquitetura/Dados: modelagem de dados e design de soluções Salesforce.
  • Processos: práticas ágeis e versionamento com Git.
  • Automação: Flow.
  • Canais/IA: Digital Engagement e Einstein Bots e AgentForce.
  • Idioma: inglês para conversação (comunicação com Suporte Global Salesforce).
  • Disponibilidade: plantão fora do horário comercial, em esquema de rodízio com o time.


Habilidades:

  • Escrever código Apex e LWC performáticos, seguros e reutilizáveis.
  • Projetar integrações resilientes e monitoráveis entre sistemas.
  • Estruturar modelos de dados consistentes e aderentes ao negócio.
  • Colaborar em definições técnicas e revisão de soluções com o time.
  • Organizar o trabalho em ciclos ágeis, mantendo rastreabilidade no Git.


Atitudes:

  • Comunicação clara e colaboração no trabalho em equipe.
  • Resolução de problemas com foco em impacto e qualidade.
  • Adaptabilidade a mudanças de contexto e prioridades.
  • Aprendizado contínuo e curiosidade pelas novidades da plataforma.


Condições da vaga

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ .
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (Home Office) .

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware | CLT | 100% Remota


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial.

Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.


O que buscamos:

  • Forte experiência em C++ e sistemas embutidos/embarcados;
  • Vivência com Linux ;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas embarcados ;
  • Experiência em otimização de performance, consumo e recursos de hardware;

title: Analista de Recebíveis
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Reuniões mensais com jurídico para tomada de decisão nas ações judiciais relacionadas a contrato de locação;
  • Mapeamento e cobrança de saldos com lojistas;
  • Recuperação de crédito;
  • Controles e planilhas para report da companhia;
  • Apresentações mensais de resultado relacionado a inadimplência;
  • Interface com lojistas e clientes externos.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação Superior completo em Administração, Comunicação, Economia, Engenharia de Produção, Direito ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pacote Office avançado, com foco em Excel;
  • Experiência com contas a receber será um diferencial.


O Que Temos Para Você

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own ServiceNow reporting and analytics governance across all modules.
  • Define and standardize KPIs, reporting cadence, and data quality frameworks.

  • Deliver executive and operational dashboards providing real-time service and performance insights.
  • Collaborate with business and platform owners to align reporting with goals and ITIL frameworks.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across ServiceNow, Power BI, and Salesforce.
  • Measure and communicate platform adoption, automation gains, and productivity improvements.
  • Stay current on ServiceNow releases, AI/Now Assist features, and emerging analytics capabilities.

  • 3+ years of ServiceNow experience (Performance Analytics, Reporting, or Data Visualization).
  • Proven ability to design dashboards across ITSM, CSM, and SPM modules.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow data models, tables, and CMDB relationships.
  • Excellent collaboration, analytical, and presentation skills.


Preferred:

  • Experience in an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Familiarity with ITIL KPI frameworks (MTTR, SLA, backlog, etc.).
  • Experience with VividCharts, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Exposure to Automation Engine, Flow Designer, or Now Assist analytics.


Certifications (Preferred):

  • ServiceNow CSA, Performance Analytics & Reporting Micro-Certs, ITIL 4 Foundation.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Sênior (Home Office)
description:
Resumo da oportunidade:

Você fará parte de um time que cria e evolui soluções no ecossistema Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud. O papel envolve desenvolvimento com alta qualidade e performance, integrações e desenho de dados, colaborando com equipes de projeto e interagindo com suporte global em inglês.


Responsabilidades do dia a dia:

  • Implementar funcionalidades no Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce/Aura) com foco em performance e qualidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações com APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata) e orquestrar processos com Flow.
  • Modelar dados e desenhar soluções aderentes ao Service Cloud.
  • Participar ativamente das definições técnicas com as equipes de projeto, propondo melhorias.
  • Versionar código com Git e colaborar em práticas ágeis do time.
  • Acompanhar novidades do Salesforce e aplicar quando fizer sentido.
  • Atuar em esquema de plantão fora do horário comercial, em rodízio com o time.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de implementação e customização no Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Stack: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, LWC, Aura, batches, triggers e schedules.
  • Integrações: experiência com Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata).
  • Arquitetura/Dados: modelagem de dados e design de soluções Salesforce.
  • Processos: práticas ágeis e versionamento com Git.
  • Automação: Flow.
  • Canais/IA: Digital Engagement e Einstein Bots e AgentForce.
  • Idioma: inglês para conversação (comunicação com Suporte Global Salesforce).
  • Disponibilidade: plantão fora do horário comercial, em esquema de rodízio com o time.


Habilidades:

  • Escrever código Apex e LWC performáticos, seguros e reutilizáveis.
  • Projetar integrações resilientes e monitoráveis entre sistemas.
  • Estruturar modelos de dados consistentes e aderentes ao negócio.
  • Colaborar em definições técnicas e revisão de soluções com o time.
  • Organizar o trabalho em ciclos ágeis, mantendo rastreabilidade no Git.


Atitudes:

  • Comunicação clara e colaboração no trabalho em equipe.
  • Resolução de problemas com foco em impacto e qualidade.
  • Adaptabilidade a mudanças de contexto e prioridades.
  • Aprendizado contínuo e curiosidade pelas novidades da plataforma.


Condições da vaga

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ .
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (Home Office) .
